result.justification: The objective is clearly stated, concerning the analysis of SARS-CoV-2 dynamics in Kazakhstan, and the methodology is well-detailed, including sample collection, PCR, and bioinformatics.

objective_evidence.quote: the purpose of this study was to analyze the dynamics of the spread of SARS-CoV-2 virus variants in Kazakhstan in the period from 2020 to 2023

method_evidence.quote: PCR with real-time detection for identification of SARS-CoV-2 virus RNA was performed using the Amplitest SARS-CoV-2 reagent kit
